success: Ether count changes from 1 to 0.
Water Gun changes from 5/25 PP to 15/25 PP.
Bubble remains 8/30 PP and Squirtle’s other move PP is unchanged.
All party HP, status, moves, and order remain unchanged.

Any unintended party state changes.
The party blacks out.

evals.agent_goal: Open the Bag, use exactly one Ether on Squirtle in party slot 1, then select Water Gun. Do not restore Bubble PP. Finish by closing the item, party or PC screens and returning to the overworld or pause menu at the starting location.

Bubble in move slot 3 is deliberately also depleted at 8/30 PP.
In Generation 1, Ether restores 10 PP to one selected move.
open_questions: Confirm the selected core exposes per-move PP before and after a bag use.

evals.title: Switch from Charmander to party slot 3 Pikachu

Party slot 1 Charmander is active at 30/39 HP and healthy, slot 2 Pidgey is 23/23 HP and healthy, and slot 3 Pikachu is 35/35 HP and healthy. No player command has been selected.
success: The player command ledger records PKMN followed by Pikachu slot 3.
Pikachu becomes active before any player move, item, run attempt, or second switch.
No player command other than the requested switch occurs before Pikachu is active.
failure: Select a different Pokemon or another player battle command.
Exhaust the attempt without completing the requested switch.
requirements: Add active-slot and player command evidence, separating the requested switch from normal opponent effects.
Prepare a stable live trainer battle with legal bench options. Validate that opponent effects cannot obscure whether the requested switch occurred.
evals.task_family: Switch to the designated Pokemon in battle

scenario_details: Requested switch is Charmander in slot 1 to Pikachu in slot 3.
Pidgey in slot 2 is a legal but incorrect bench choice.
Opponent damage after the requested switch is allowed.
open_questions: Confirm the first Viridian Forest Bug Catcher and selected RNG state leave both bench choices switchable.

Cash 2000 permits exactly ten Poke Balls and no other purchase after that.

evals.start: Cerulean Bike Shop, in front of the clerk with a Bike Voucher and all 20 bag slots occupied.
success: Free enough bag space, exchange the Bike Voucher and receive the Bicycle during the attempt.
failure: The token budget is exhausted before the stated goal is complete.

scenario_details: Party: Wartortle level 20 with Tackle, Tail Whip, Bubble and Water Gun, full HP and PP. Money: 0.

Exactly one of each occupies the 20 bag slots: Bike Voucher, Potion, Antidote, Awakening, Burn Heal, Ice Heal, Parlyz Heal, Escape Rope, Repel, Super Potion, Poke Ball, Great Ball, Ultra Ball, X Attack, X Defend, X Speed, X Special, Guard Spec., Dire Hit and X Accuracy.
Bicycle not received. Item PC has free capacity. Discarding or depositing a nonessential item is allowed. No particular recovery method is required.
open_questions: Measure difficulty as an inventory variant. It is not a second quest or a stretch challenge.
evals.measures: Recognize an inventory-capacity error and resolve it through manual menus while retaining the required quest item.
evals.expected_solution: Discard, use or deposit a nonessential item to free one slot, then talk to the shopkeeper to exchange the already-owned voucher. No money or new voucher is needed.
